items.name: Kiln Cargo Frame
items.prompt: A cargo expansion module: a thin-walled box frame cast from pale, satin-gray alloy with a faint pearly sheen. Open lattice ribs along the sides show the empty hold inside. Small stenciled hazard stripes and a load rating plate. It should look lighter and more precise than an ordinary steel cargo pod.

items.name: Lattice Fuel Cell
items.prompt: A compact fuel tank. Through narrow windows in its pale gray alloy casing you can see a translucent, blue-white crystal lattice inside, like honeycomb, holding the fuel. A fuel coupling on one end.

items.name: Lattice Shield Weave
items.prompt: A ship shield generator: a dark, heavy base unit topped with an emitter wrapped in a fine woven mesh of pale cyan crystal threads that glow faintly. Industrial, functional, not magical.

items.name: Foundry Ion Drive
items.prompt: A starship ion engine that combines a main thruster nozzle and small side steering vents in a single seamless casting of pale gray alloy, with no visible bolts or seams. A faint blue glow deep inside the nozzle.

items.name: Lattice Lance
items.prompt: A ship-mounted laser cannon with a long barrel. Slots along the barrel reveal a clear, faceted crystal rod running down its length. Gray alloy housing, power cables at the back.

items.name: Deepworks Fusion Core
items.prompt: A squat cylindrical power generator in dull gray alloy, designed six hundred years ago by a mining company. Cooling channels in organic, branching patterns are grown into the casing. A riveted, old-fashioned part number plate on the side. Sturdy, conservative, industrial.

items.name: Foundry Hauler
items.prompt: A huge, blocky bulk freighter with a long rectangular hull and cargo pods along its spine. Smooth, seamless cast plating of pale gray alloy with yellow industrial markings. Built by an independent captain's own station, not a big shipyard: practical and a little rough.

items.name: Foundry Hauler
items.prompt: The same bulk freighter as the top-down sprite: a long, blocky hull with cargo pods along its spine, pale gray alloy plating with yellow industrial markings.

items.name: Deepworks Warden
items.prompt: A heavy warship with a long, broad spine and four forward guns. Its design is six hundred years old, drawn up by a mining company to escort ore convoys: rugged, boxy armor in gray-green with faded orange company stripes. Built new from the old plans, so the paint is fresh but the shapes are old-fashioned.
